name: Openitem.count equals unpaid invoice rows in range, tenant-scoped
note: The reference mirrors the cube's join chain exactly, including two joins that can MULTIPLY rows and therefore change the count: c_invoicepayschedule (one row per instalment on an invoice) and c_acctschema (one row per accounting schema matching client+org). A simplified count(*) on c_invoice would not match, and that is not a discrepancy - it is what the cube actually counts. Openitem also has no docstatus filter; ispaid='N' is the only gate.
referenceSql: SELECT count(*) AS value FROM c_invoice i LEFT JOIN c_invoicepayschedule ips ON i.c_invoice_id = ips.c_invoice_id AND i.ispaid ='N' LEFT JOIN C_DunningLevel dl ON dl.C_DunningLevel_ID=i.C_DunningLevel_ID LEFT JOIN c_acctschema ac ON ac.ad_client_id = i.ad_client_id AND (ac.ad_orgonly_id = i.ad_org_id) JOIN c_doctype dt ON i.c_doctype_id = dt.c_doctype_id JOIN c_paymentterm p ON i.c_paymentterm_id = p.c_paymentterm_id WHERE i.ispaid ='N' AND i.ad_client_id=1000026 AND i.dateinvoiced >= DATE '2026-01-01' AND i.dateinvoiced < DATE '2026-09-01'
